title: Figure 5. Combined Random-Attitude and Slow-Turn Results (Atlas IIAS)
description: Semi-log line graph of "Percent in 5-deg sector (%)" versus "Angle From Flight Path (deg)" from 0 to 180, titled in-plot "Atlas IIAS Failures through 280 sec" with "Breakup q-alpha = 20,000 deg-lb/ft^2." Three marked series (random-attitude turns, slow turns, and combined turns at 0.75 random + 0.25 slow) fall steeply from near 100% to below 1% beyond about 60 degrees.
